turns.user_utterance: Why am I being charged twice fro a restaurant?
turns.assistant_response: I’m sorry about that—sounds like your card payment to the restaurant may have been processed twice. Can you confirm whether you see two separate charges/transactions for the same amount (and roughly the same time) in your card statement?

turns.user_utterance: Yes, I see two identical charges for the same amount on the same day.
turns.assistant_response: Got it—if you see two identical charges for the same amount on the same day, that’s typically a “charged twice” card payment issue. Please share the merchant name and the date/time of the charges (or the last 4 digits of the transaction references) so I can guide you on the next steps to get this resolved.
